{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

# Test R05: preview doesn't consume IDs
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)

# Preview returns [1] but shouldn't consume the ID
ids = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
assert ids == [1], f'Preview returned {ids}'

# Preview again should still return [1]
ids2 = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}])
assert ids2 == [1], f'Preview consumed IDs, returned {ids2}'

# Now apply - should return [1]
ids3 = w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
assert ids3 == [1], f'Apply returned {ids3}'

# Next preview after apply should return [2]
ids4 = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}}])
assert ids4 == [2], f'After apply, preview returned {ids4}'

print('R05 preview ID preservation: PASS')

# Test R05: failed preview doesn't consume IDs
ids5 = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}, {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 999}])
# This preview should return [2] (the insert would succeed) but NOT consume it
assert ids5 == [2], f'Failed preview returned {ids5}'

# Next preview should still return [2]
ids6 = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 4}}])
assert ids6 == [2], f'After failed preview, returned {ids6}'

print('R05 failed preview: PASS')

# Test R07: idempotency token
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w2 = BatchWriter(db2)

ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
result1 = w2.apply(ops, token='t1')
assert result1 == [1]

# Same token, same ops = idempotent
result2 = w2.apply(ops, token='t1')
assert result2 == [1]

# Same token, different ops = ValueError
try:
    w2.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}], token='t1')
    print('FAIL: should have raised ValueError for different ops with same token')
except ValueError:
    print('R07 token conflict: PASS')

# Different token, same ops = new insert
db_len_before = len(db2)
result3 = w2.apply(ops, token='t2')
assert result3 == [2], f'Different token should insert new doc, got {result3}'
print('R07 new token: PASS')

# None token means normal operation
result4 = w2.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 1}}], token=None)
assert result4 == [3]
print('R07 None token: PASS')

# Invalid tokens
try:
    w2.apply(ops, token='')
    print('FAIL: should reject empty token')
except ValueError:
    print('R07 empty token rejected: PASS')

try:
    w2.apply(ops, token=123)
    print('FAIL: should reject non-string token')
except ValueError:
    print('R07 non-string token rejected: PASS')

# Failed batch doesn't consume token
try:
    w2.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 999}], token='fail_token')
except ValueError:
    pass

# Reusing 'fail_token' with same ops should work (failed batches don't consume tokens)
result5 = w2.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 999}], token='fail_token')
# Should still raise because the operation itself fails (doc 999 doesn't exist)
try:
    result5 = w2.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 999}], token='fail_token')
    print(f'FAIL: should still fail, got {result5}')
except ValueError:
    print('R07 failed batch no token consumed: PASS')

print('ALL R05+R07 TESTS PASSED')
